column3: Closest parallel: Israelite covenant joins prayer and zakat with additional obligations and a breach outcome.
Pericope context shows a group altering what it heard, framing the later covenant failure.
Maps material care across parents, kin, orphans, and poor people, extending the covenant's care network.
Near-parallel worship-and-care command expands the named network to neighbors, companions, travelers, and dependents.
Immediate continuation specifies communal nonviolence and non-expulsion as covenant obligations.
Concentrates orphanhood and kinship, sharpening the vulnerable-near relation already named.
Integrates belief, material care, prayer, zakat, and covenant-keeping into one sustained ethical pattern.
Provides nearby context about deficient engagement with the Book but adds little to the listed duties.
Shows a distinct distribution setting in which kin, orphans, poor people, and travelers receive shares.
Joins provision for kin, orphans, and poor people with fitting speech to them.
